svg.title: Which missingness label applies?
svg.desc: A decision tree for an input that is not in front of the reader. If a record is available but fails the freshness requirement, the label is stale. Otherwise, if the check or assessment was not performed, not assessed. Otherwise, if the reader's principal may not read the source, inaccessible. Otherwise, if the source or dependency did not answer, unavailable. Otherwise, if no scoped retrieval completed, missing. Otherwise, if an adequately scoped observation of absence was made with method, time and complete coverage, negative; if not, not retrieved, which is not evidence of absence.

span.p: An expected input is not in front of the reader

div.style: color: rgb(11, 37, 64) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 330px; text-align: center; width: 330px;

span.p: 1 A record is available but fails the freshness requirement?

div.style: color: rgb(11, 37, 64) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 330px; text-align: center;

span.p: 2 Was the check or assessment performed?

div.style: color: rgb(11, 37, 64) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 330px; text-align: center;

span.p: 3 May the reader's principal read the source?

div.style: color: rgb(11, 37, 64) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 330px; text-align: center;

span.p: 4 Did the source or dependency answer?

div.style: color: rgb(11, 37, 64) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 330px; text-align: center;
color: rgb(11, 37, 64) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 330px; text-align: center; width: 330px;

span.p: 6 Was absence observed, with method, time and complete coverage?

div.style: color: rgb(61, 37, 0) !important; display: table; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 330px; text-align: center; width: 120px;
color: rgb(61, 37, 0) !important; display: table; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 330px; text-align: center; width: 120px;

span.p:
inaccessible
reason and existence disclosed only when permitted

div.style: color: rgb(61, 37, 0) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 330px; text-align: center;

span.p:
unavailable
not the same as denied

div.style: color: rgb(61, 37, 0) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 330px; text-align: center; width: 330px;

span.p:
missing
expected, not obtained; reason may be unknown

div.style: color: rgb(61, 37, 0) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 330px; text-align: center;

span.p:
negative
an adequately scoped observation of absence

div.style: color: rgb(61, 37, 0) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 330px; text-align: center; width: 330px;

span.p:
not_retrieved
a completed retrieval found nothing; not evidence of absence
